backend-di:
flowchart TD
    Dispatcher["Dispatcher: scoped"] --> Uow["IUnitOfWork: scoped"]
    Handler["Handler: scoped"] --> Repo["Repository: scoped"]
    Uow --> Context["Shared AppDbContext in this scope"]
    Repo --> Context
    Context --> Audit["Audit interceptor: scoped"]
    Context --> Guard["Tenant guard: singleton"]
    Context --> Timestamp["Timestamp interceptor: singleton"]
    Timestamp --> Clock["Clock: singleton"]
backend-dispatcher:
flowchart TD
    Input["Command"] --> Validate["Validate shape"]
    Validate --> Tenant["Check tenant marker"]
    Tenant --> Permission["Check required permission"]
    Permission --> Begin["Begin transaction and set tenant"]
    Begin --> Handle["Handler"]
    Handle --> Result{"Success?"}
    Result -->|no| Rollback["Rollback"]
    Result -->|yes| Save["Save business and audit changes"]
    Save --> Saved{"Save success?"}
    Saved -->|no| Rollback
    Saved -->|yes| Commit["Commit"]
backend-results:
flowchart LR
    Business["Expected business refusal"] --> Error["Error and failed Result"]
    Error --> Map["Result HTTP mapping"]
    Map --> Problem["Problem Details"]
    Fault["Unexpected exception"] --> Cleanup["Rollback and rethrow"]
    Cleanup --> Handler["Global exception handler"]
    Handler --> Problem
backend-transactions:
sequenceDiagram
    participant D as Dispatcher
    participant U as UnitOfWork
    participant P as PostgreSQL
    D->>U: Begin query
    U->>P: BEGIN
    U->>P: SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY
    U->>P: set_config local centre
    D->>P: Handler reads through adapter
    D->>U: Commit
    U->>P: COMMIT
    Note over D,P: Query pipeline never calls SaveChanges
backend-concurrency:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Enrollment A
    participant P as Group row
    participant B as Enrollment B
    A->>P: FOR UPDATE granted
    B->>P: FOR UPDATE waits
    A->>P: Count active and insert last seat
    A->>P: Commit releases lock
    P-->>B: Lock granted
    B->>P: Count includes committed enrollment
    B->>B: Domain returns group.full
    B->>P: Rollback
backend-tenancy:
flowchart TD
    Cookie["Validated membership selection"] --> Actor["Actor centre"]
    Actor --> Gate["Request tenant gate"]
    Gate --> Filter["EF global read filter"]
    Gate --> Guard["Tracked write guard"]
    Actor --> Setting["Transaction-local app.current_centre"]
    Setting --> RLS["PostgreSQL forced RLS"]
    Keys["Composite tenant keys"] --> Relationships["Same-centre references"]
backend-authentication:
sequenceDiagram
    participant B as Browser
    participant A as API
    participant I as Identity adapter
    participant D as Dispatcher
    B->>A: Antiforgery token request
    A-->>B: Request token and cookie token
    B->>A: Login JSON and request token header
    A->>I: Verify credentials
    I-->>A: User ID and stamp
    A->>D: Read profile and active memberships
    D-->>A: Me DTO
    A-->>B: Me DTO and protected session cookie
backend-permissions:
flowchart TD
    Request["Application request"] --> Marker{"Requires permission?"}
    Marker -->|no| Continue["Continue pipeline"]
    Marker -->|yes| Actor{"Actor type"}
    Actor -->|system| Continue
    Actor -->|staff with role| Map["RolePermissions.Holds"]
    Actor -->|other| Deny["auth.permission_denied"]
    Map -->|yes| Continue
    Map -->|no| Deny
    Continue --> Scope["Read services also apply teacher scope where relevant"]
backend-audit:
flowchart LR
    Changes["Tracked business changes"] --> Timestamp["Timestamp interceptor"]
    Timestamp --> Audit["Audit policy and masked diff"]
    Audit --> Added["Add audit rows to same context"]
    Added --> Guard["Tenant and append-only guard"]
    Guard --> Save["One save in open transaction"]
    Save --> Commit["Business and audit commit together"]
backend-academics:
erDiagram
    STUDENT ||--o{ STUDENT_PARENT_LINK : has
    PARENT ||--o{ STUDENT_PARENT_LINK : linked
    SUBJECT ||--o{ GROUP : classifies
    TEACHER ||--o{ GROUP : teaches
    STUDENT ||--o{ ENROLLMENT : joins
    GROUP ||--o{ ENROLLMENT : contains
    GROUP ||--o{ SCHEDULE_RULE : repeats
    SCHEDULE_RULE ||--o{ CLASS_SESSION : generates
backend-scheduling:
flowchart LR
    Rule["Weekday and local wall time"] --> Dates["Visit inclusive calendar dates"]
    Dates --> Occurs{"Rule occurs?"}
    Occurs -->|yes| Local["Date plus local time"]
    Local --> Zone["Explicit centre zone and DST policy"]
    Zone --> Start["UTC start instant"]
    Start --> End["Add elapsed duration"]
    End --> Session["Dated session"]
    Session --> Database["Persist with overlap constraints"]
frontend-react:
flowchart LR
    Component["Component subscribes"] --> Observer["Query observer"]
    Observer --> Cache["Cache entry by query key"]
    Cache --> Fetch["Query function calls client"]
    Fetch --> Result["HTTP data or error"]
    Result --> Cache
    Cache --> Notify["Observer notification"]
    Notify --> Render["React render and DOM commit"]
infra-test-strategy:
flowchart TD
    Browser["Browser journeys: real system seams"] --> HTTP["API tests: real pipeline"]
    HTTP --> Store["Infrastructure tests: real PostgreSQL"]
    Store --> Application["Application tests: orchestration and fakes"]
    Application --> Domain["Domain tests: deterministic invariants"]
    Architecture["Architecture tests: compiled structure"] --> Application
infra-compose-roles:
flowchart LR
    PG["PostgreSQL healthy"] --> Migrate["Owner migration job"]
    Migrate --> Seed["Demo seed job"]
    Seed --> App["Runtime app: restricted DB connection"]
    Caddy["Caddy TLS proxy"] --> App
    App --> PG
    Browser["Browser on localhost:8443"] --> Caddy
infra-ci:
flowchart TD
    Event["PR or main push"] --> Backend["Backend build, drift and tests"]
    Event --> Frontend["Frontend generation, lint, types, tests, build"]
    Backend --> E2E["Real API browser journeys"]
    Frontend --> E2E
    Event --> Container["Production image and migration verification"]
    Container --> Smoke["Local production-style smoke"]
infra-telemetry:
flowchart TD
    Endpoint{"Otel endpoint configured?"} -->|no| Off["Return without exporters"]
    Endpoint -->|yes| Resource["Service name and version"]
    Resource --> Traces["HTTP and Npgsql traces"]
    Resource --> Metrics["HTTP metrics"]
    Resource --> Logs["Telemetry logging provider"]
    Traces --> OTLP["Configured OTLP collector"]
    Metrics --> OTLP
    Logs --> OTLP
